```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(effects)
library(emmeans)
library(simr)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(MuMIn)
```

#reading in data
```{r}
studyone <- read.csv(file = '../data/studyone.csv')
studytwo <- read.csv(file = '../data/studytwo.csv')
studythree <- read.csv(file='../data/studythree.csv')
studyfour <- read.csv(file='../data/studyfour.csv')
studysix <- read.csv(file='../data/studysix.csv')
studyseven <- read.csv(file='../data/studyseven.csv')
studyeight <- read.csv(file='../data/studyeight.csv')
```

#data cleaning for study one analyses
```{r}
studyone$subject <- as.factor(studyone$subject)
studyone$clipnum <- as.factor(studyone$clipnum)

#convert to long form for interaction model
studyoneinteraction <-
  studyone %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,7,9)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = manip_like, "Original" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")


studyoneinteraction$liking_scaled <- scale(studyoneinteraction$liking)
studyoneinteraction$rep_scaled <- scale(studyoneinteraction$rep)
studyoneinteraction$outcome_type <- as.factor(studyoneinteraction$outcome_type)

studyoneinteractionfam <-
  studyone %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,8,10)) %>%
  rename("Altered" = man_fam, "Original" = post_fam) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "familiarity")

studyoneinteractionfam$outcome_type <- as.factor(studyoneinteractionfam$outcome_type)
studyoneinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled <- scale(studyoneinteractionfam$familiarity)
studyoneinteractionfam$rep_scaled <- scale(studyoneinteractionfam$rep)
```

#study one analysis
```{r}
## liking ratings
contrasts(studyoneinteraction$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)
m1 <- lmer(liking_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyoneinteraction)
summary(m1)
test(emtrends(m1, "outcome_type",var = "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 3345))

## familiarity ratings
contrasts(studyoneinteractionfam$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)
m1f <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyoneinteractionfam)
summary(m1f)
test(emtrends(m1f, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 3351))
```

#data cleaning for study six analyses
```{r}
studysix$subject <- as.factor(studysix$subject)
studysix$clipnum <- as.factor(studysix$clipnum)

#convert to long form for interaction model
studysixinteraction <-
  studysix %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,8,10)) %>%
  rename("Original" = manip_like, "Altered" = post_like) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "liking")


studysixinteraction$liking_scaled <- scale(studysixinteraction$liking)
studysixinteraction$rep_scaled <- scale(studysixinteraction$rep)
studysixinteraction$outcome_type <- as.factor(studysixinteraction$outcome_type)
studysixinteraction <- within(studysixinteraction, outcome_type <- relevel(outcome_type, ref = "Original"))

studysixinteractionfam <-
  studysix %>%
  subset(select=c(2,3,4,9,11)) %>%
  rename("Original" = man_fam, "Altered" = post_fam) %>%
  pivot_longer(Original:Altered, names_to = "outcome_type", values_to = "familiarity")

studysixinteractionfam$outcome_type <- as.factor(studysixinteractionfam$outcome_type)
studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled <- scale(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity)
studysixinteractionfam$rep_scaled <- scale(studysixinteractionfam$rep)
studysixinteractionfam <- within(studysixinteractionfam, outcome_type <- relevel(outcome_type, ref = "Original"))
```

#study six analysis
```{r}
contrasts(studysixinteraction$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)
```

#plotting
```{r}
ggplot(data=studysixinteraction, aes(x=rep, y=liking)) +
  ylab('Liking Rating') +
  xlab('Number of Presentations') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type), data=studysixinteraction) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type), data=studysixinteraction)

#fam ratings
newdata <- expand.grid(
  rep_scaled=seq(-1.2,1.8,0.001),
  outcome_type = c("Original", "Altered")
)
predictions<- predictSE(m1f, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, print.matrix =
        TRUE, level = 0)

pred_minimeta <- cbind(newdata, predictions)

pred_minimeta$rep <- pred_minimeta$rep_scaled * attr(studysixinteractionfam$rep_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(studysixinteractionfam$rep_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$familiarity <- pred_minimeta$fit * attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$upper <- (pred_minimeta$fit + pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')
pred_minimeta$lower <- (pred_minimeta$fit - pred_minimeta$se.fit) * attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:scale') + attr(studysixinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled, 'scaled:center')

labels <- subset(pred_minimeta, rep==median(pred_minimeta$rep))
labels$label_placement <- ifelse(labels$outcome_type=="Original", labels$upper,labels$lower)

ggplot(data=studysixinteractionfam, aes(x=rep, y=familiarity)) +
  ylab('Familiarity Rating') +
  xlab('Number of Presentations') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type))
```

#meta over study 1 + 6
```{r}
#fam ratings
## re-coding so that for study 6, original = no pred error, altered = pred error
studyoneinteractionfam$study <- "Study 1"
studyoneinteractionfam$outcome_type <- ifelse(studyoneinteractionfam$outcome_type=="Original", "Exposed", "Not Exposed")
studysixinteractionfam$outcome_type <- ifelse(studysixinteractionfam$outcome_type=="Altered", "Exposed", "Not Exposed")
studysixinteractionfam$study <- "Study 6"

study1_6f <- rbind(studyoneinteractionfam, studysixinteractionfam)
  
study1_6f$familiarity_scaled <- scale(study1_6f$familiarity)
study1_6f$rep_scaled <- scale(study1_6f$rep)
study1_6f$outcome_type <- as.factor(study1_6f$outcome_type)

study1_6f$study <- as.factor(study1_6f$study)
contrasts(study1_6f$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)

m1_6f <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ study*outcome_type*rep_scaled + (rep_scaled|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=study1_6f,control=lmerControl(optimizer = c("bobyqa")))
summary(m1_6f)

#plotting
labels <- subset(study1_6f,subject == "54849ec4fdf99b0379939d1d") %>%
  subset(rep==8) %>%
  subset(clipnum==12)


labels$label_placement <- ifelse(labels$outcome_type=="Exposed", 4.95,3.75)

minimeta2_fam<-
ggplot(data=study1_6f, aes(x=rep, y=familiarity)) +
  ylab('Familiarity Rating') +
  xlab('Exposure (number of presentations)') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
    strip.text.x = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#E69F00")) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.2, aes(color=outcome_type), alpha=0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = 'mean_cl_normal', geom = 'pointrange', aes(color=outcome_type),alpha=0.7) +
  facet_grid(~study) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = outcome_type, y=label_placement, color=outcome_type),
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   data=labels, 
                   min.segment.length = Inf,
                   point.size = NA,
                   family="Arial",
                   size=8
                   )
```

```{r}
studyeight$subject <- as.factor(studyeight$subject)
studyeight$clipnum <- as.factor(studyeight$clipnum)

#filtering out duplicates

  studyeight %>%
  filter_at(vars(subject), all_vars(!. %in% c('310', '333', '337', '361')))

studyeightinteractionfam$outcome_type = as.factor(studyeightinteractionfam$outcome_type)
contrasts(studyeightinteractionfam$outcome_type) <- c(-.5,.5)
studyeightinteractionfam$familiarity_scaled <- scale(studyeightinteractionfam$familiarity)
studyeightinteractionfam$rep_scaled <- scale(studyeightinteractionfam$rep)
```

#study eight analysis
```{r}
## liking ratings
m5 <- lmer(liking_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteraction,control=lmerControl(optimizer = c("bobyqa")))
summary(m5)
test(emtrends(m5, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 4000))

## familiarity ratings
m5f <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteractionfam)
summary(m5f)
test(emtrends(m5f, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 4000))

##model fitting ### see "bmrq_analysis script for fitting these models to studies 1-4
#fam ratings
linmodelf <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteractionfam, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))
summary(linmodelf)
test(emtrends(linmodelf, ~outcome_type, "rep_scaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14585))
r.squaredGLMM(linmodelf)
#logarithmic 
studyeightinteractionfam$log_rep <- log10(studyeightinteractionfam$rep + 0.1)
studyeightinteractionfam$log_repscaled <- scale(studyeightinteractionfam$log_rep)
logmodelf <- lmer(familiarity_scaled ~ log_repscaled*outcome_type  + (log_repscaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteractionfam)
summary(logmodelf)
test(emtrends(logmodelf, ~outcome_type, "log_repscaled", lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 14585))
r.squaredGLMM(logmodelf)

anova(linmodelf, logmodelf)

#liking ratings
linmodel <-lmer(liking_scaled ~ rep_scaled*outcome_type + (rep_scaled*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteraction,control=lmerControl(optimizer = c("bobyqa")))
quadmodel <- lmer(liking_scaled ~ poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type + (poly(rep_scaled,2,raw=TRUE)*outcome_type|subject) + (1|clipnum), data=studyeightinteraction,control=lmerControl(optimizer = c("bobyqa")))
anova(linmodel, quadmodel)
```
